centroid.meaning: provisional center of selected visible returns; not a solved physical rotation axis or canonical robot origin
centroid.method: coordinate-wise median of accepted per-frame candidate medians

point_time_semantics: header_timestamp_ns + point_time_offset_ns where valid; otherwise header timestamp for the scan, with point_time_offset_valid=false

selection.method: per-frame DBSCAN cluster ranked by nominal radial distance and broad robot dimensions
